entities.summary: In Thailand, cannabis, known by the name Ganja, was decriminalised in 2022. Cannabis extracts and products are officially limited to 0.2% tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content. Only medicinal use is legal, but in practice there is widespread recreational usage, with rules passed in July 2025 aiming to curb that usage.
